phrases.latin: Lagoenam vīnī aperī, sīs; hospitēs adsunt.
phrases.english: Open a bottle of wine, please; our guests are here.

phrases.latin: Quasi tū lagoenam dīcās, ubi vīnum Chium solet esse.
phrases.english: As if you were talking of a bottle that Chian wine is kept in.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
